strategy.versioning: v1 implicit; v2 reported or unknown with explicit provenance marker
strategy.migration: bounded candidate batches, claims, content comparison and resumable journal
strategy.rollback: remove only this run's fields if complete document is unchanged

cases.normal: Real migration with unchanged legacy consumer in four phases
cases.declaredFailure: Conflicting update and interruption between data write and journal confirmation

limitations: No AWS deployment or cross-document transaction
Serialize operations on the same runId
